item.description: Hey guys. I recently watched the latency reports for my local voice assistant, which show a waveform plus silero probability for voice activity. My idea was to use a 10 ms energy detector with a threshold that adapts to environment or room noise. Which worked amazingly well. item.title: Show HN: Cerulion – ROS 2-compatible robotics runtime with multi-process replay
item.description: Hey HN! I'm Lakshay. Raveen and I have built Cerulion, a ROS2-compatible robotics runtime written in Rust. We've worked hard on lowering IPC transport latencies without making the single process tradeoff or forcing POD message types. These fast multi-process graphs can then be resimmed deterministically, and existing ROS2 nodes/launch files can run unmodified alongside native Cerulion Rust/Python code.
